notes.title: Version 2.20 Out Now!
notes.notes: [p]Version 2.20 was released on August 5 and introduces the new playable character Willnas in addition to the content included with Battle Pass Round 9. Additionally, new playable “EX character” versions of Gran, Djeeta, and Narmaya have been added. Experience new twists on familiar characters with all new mechanics and skills![/p][p][/p][p][b]Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising – Wilnas Gameplay Trailer[/b][/p][previewyoutube="2qMoJ32Ists;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]Wilnas the Vermillion of the Six Dragons Joins the Roster as a Playable Character![/b][/p][p]Wilnas is now obtainable as a DLC character.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3745460"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]EX Character Versions of Gran, Djeeta, and Narmaya Now Playable![/b][/p][p]From Version 2.20, players will be able to select EX character versions of Gran, Djeeta, and Narmaya. EX characters possess different skills and mechanics from their standard counterparts, allowing players to experience a new twist on familiar characters.[/p][p] [/p][p]- EX characters cannot be used in story mode.[/p][p]- EX characters share rankings, Versus ranks, and character levels with their standard counterparts.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Battle Pass Round 9 Available Now![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44470151/9bfd687a355ccd3103b179ec48c71e2e29b5271d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The latest battle pass, Battle Pass Round 9, includes additional in-game items that can be unlocked, such as music, stickers, badges, trophies, and more. This premium avatar set also includes exclusive badges that can be set on your profile.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Premium Battle Pass Round 4 Rewards Are Coming Back![/b][/p][p]A character costume, character colors, and weapon skins from Round 4 can once again be obtained![/p][p] [/p][p]Character Costume[/p][p]• Beatrix (Indigo Witch)[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3745470"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Character Color Set: Battle Pass Pack 4[/p][p]• Charlotta (Color 22)[/p][p]• Soriz (Color 22)[/p][p]• Yuel (Color 22)[/p][p]• Siegfried (Color 22)[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3745480"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Weapon Skin Set: Battle Pass Pack 4[/p][p]• Gran (Prototype)[/p][p]• Metera (Eon)[/p][p]• Lowain (Wales' Finest)[/p][p]• Ferry (Flame Lit Curl)[/p][p]• Beatrix (Embrasque Demiclone)[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3745490"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][u]- These products include previously released Premium Battle Pass Round 4 rewards. notes.title: Version 2.10 Available Now!
notes.notes:
Version 2.10 was released on May 28 and introduces the new playable character Galleon in addition to the content included with Battle Pass Round 8.

[b]Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising – Galleon Gameplay Trailer[/b]
[previewyoutube=saOTUEfzyPw;full][/previewyoutube]

Galleon the Gold of the Six Dragons Joins the Roster as a Playable Character!
Galleon is now obtainable as a DLC character.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3604390/GBVSR/

[b]Battle Pass Round 8[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44470151/1f0cbabe1526e4ffa21e98f7fd5d87d4ec434f4d.png[/img]

The latest battle pass, Battle Pass Round 8, includes additional in-game items that can be unlocked, such as illustrations, stickers, badges, trophies, and more. A new lobby avatar, Wubbly Galleon, can also be obtained as a battle pass reward.

[url=https://rising.granbluefantasy.jp/en/dlc/battlepass/09]https://rising.granbluefantasy.jp/en/dlc/battlepass/09[/url]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44470151/47846058b8f37ebb87341cf51496a25b66c1812e.png[/img]

[b]Changes to Ranked Matches[/b]
The five-diamond format used previously will be replaced with a numeric point-based system for improved accuracy. Versus ranks will now increase or decrease upon reaching specific point thresholds. The promotion trial system has also been removed with the introduction of the reworked ranked match system.
See the announcement on our official site for more details:
[url=https://rising.granbluefantasy.jp/en/news/detail/?id=8t3m2l_g3nn0]https://rising.granbluefantasy.jp/en/news/detail/?id=8t3m2l_g3nn0[/url]

[b]Premium Battle Pass Round 3 Rewards Are Coming Back![/b]
A character costume, character colors, and weapon skins from Round 3 can once again be obtained!
Character Costume
・Seox (Sinborne Redeemer)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3604400/GBVSR/

[b]Grand Bruise! Points Added to Grand Bruise Legends! [/b]
A new Grand Bruise! point system has been added. Players can collect points to unlock new rewards.

See the Version 2.10 Patch Notes here:
[url=https://rising.granbluefantasy.jp/en/news/detail/?id=xr2dnxjz8]https://rising.granbluefantasy.jp/en/news/detail/?id=xr2dnxjz8[/url]

notes.title: Version 2.00 is Live!
notes.notes:
We launched Version 2.00 on February 26, introducing Sandalphon as a playable character. This update also marks the beginning of Battle Pass Round 7 and includes character adjustments and various other new features.

[b]Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising – Sandalphon Gameplay Trailer[/b]
[previewyoutube=KheKkiZmR6c;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Sandalphon, the Primarch of Promises, Descends![/b]
A new playable character, Sandalphon, has been added to the roster of playable characters.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3397140/GBVSR/

[b]Battle Pass Round 7 is Live![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44470151/c6ea389996691054f0b3b87a6eb99f3ed8c92408.png[/img]
With Battle Pass Round 7, players can unlock new rewards such as music, badges, trophies, various in-game items, and a lobby avatar of Ewiyar. 
https://rising.granbluefantasy.jp/en/dlc/battlepass/08
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44470151/f3c77a62996d3dbec3c51fd18a714febe429dda2.png[/img]

[b]Deluxe Character Pass 2 is Here![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44470151/2b8646c3e5ddf1e7ecf2eb60d4a97f75b2e81995.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3287490/GBVSR___Part2/
Sandalphon can also be unlocked via Deluxe Character Pass 2 and Character Pass 2, alongside four other DLC characters that are to be released in future updates.

• Sandalphon (Feb 26, 2025)
• Galleon (Spring 2025)
• Wilnas (Summer 2025)
• Meg (Fall 2025)
• Ilsa (Early 2026)

In addition to unlocking five additional characters as they become available, Deluxe Character Pass 2 comes with 4 color variants and 3 weapon skins for the characters included, the Canaan Shrine stage, and an exclusive Sandalphon (Dark) premium avatar.

[b]Pop Team Epic Has Invaded the Skies of GBVSR![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3380200/GBVSR/
Popuko and Pipimi, the beloved protagonists of the popular surreal comedy web comic and animated series Pop Team Epic can now be set as your lobby avatar. Additionally, they can serve as partners to advise and encourage you during gameplay and come with unique profile badges.

[b]Version 2.00 Patch Notes[/b]
https://rising.granbluefantasy.jp/en/news/detail/?id=91-vxmqh-t1x

notes.title: Vikala Joins GBVSR Roster in Version 1.60 Update
notes.notes:
The Version 1.60 update to GBVSR was released on October 25. This update comes with the new playable character Vikala and additional in-game content such as stickers and illustrations included with Battle Pass Round 6.

[b]Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising – Vikala Gameplay Trailer[/b]
[previewyoutube=8yQxrR9Mtc4;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Vikala, Guardian of the North, Joins the Roster as a Playable Character![/b]
Vikala is now obtainable as a DLC character. This addition to the roster includes a Premium Avatar of her that can be set as a Partner Character to give you advice and support while playing, a character badge, and more!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2720410/Granblue_Fantasy_Versus_Rising/
 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44470151/9a4288e9b56099b546f446214eb9d0332383ffb9.png[/img]
Vikala (Voice: Hayden Daviau [EN] / Atsumi Tanezaki [JP])
As one of the Twelve Divine Generals, she has been entrusted to watch over and protect the Northern skies from evil and corruption. Despite being known for her positive and cheerful demeanor, once her headband comes off, she reverts to the shy, introverted girl she has always been inside. Ever at her side is Dormouse, her sentient mousetrap companion.

[b]New Character Costume and More Content Coming with Battle Pass Round 6[/b]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44470151/f0946a5aadc31ad960ef5055a966b9b3c37ad702.png[/img]
The latest battle pass, Battle Pass Round 6, includes additional in-game items that can be unlocked, such as character illustrations, music, badges, trophies, and more. A new lobby avatar, Yunicorn, can also be obtained as a battle pass reward.

Players can obtain even more rewards by purchasing the Premium Battle Pass Round 6 DLC, which includes a Spooky Vicky costume for Vikala in addition to exclusive character colors and weapon skins.

https://rising.granbluefantasy.jp/en/dlc/battlepass/07

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44470151/ade32a6183f3b4df5eee7e57527ad207f0a48353.png[/img]
